recipes.profile_device: D=SHA256(UTF8(canonical_unsigned_utf8)); fill request_sha256=lowerhex(D) only when model defines it as own digest; MESSAGE=ASCII(fixed domain ending LF)||D; ECDSA P-256/SHA256 message API; encode r32||s32 as unpadded canonical base64url. Never sign hex(D) or use Prehashed(D).
recipes.admission_trusted: Omit only proof_b64url from full exact model, JCS then SHA256. Retain original admission request_sha256 reference in recover/exchange digest. proof_b64url signs fixed domain||raw digest. Do not insert a local request_sha256 field in submit/poll/trusted models.
recipes.portable_root: Construct full exact PortableRegister/PortableLogin.request, preserving unchanged passport1, exact stored v2 challenge and equal platform/version. MESSAGE=ASCII(autplay:portable-account:register:v2 plus LF) or login purpose plus UTF8(JCS(request)); ECDSA ROOT P-256/SHA256 message API, DER signature, standard canonical padded base64. Outer object exactly request/proof; no additional device signature or request hash. Narrow server retention exception: grant-producing REGISTER/LOGIN ROOT authorization MUST be HASH-ONLY. Retain server-internal root_proof_sha256 bytes=SHA256(original canonical DER signature bytes), full-original outer canonical digest, request digest and necessary nonsecret scope/challenge/binding fields. Never raw DER/base64 proof, nested parsed/body alias or encrypted ROOT-proof receipt/log. No wire hash member or response change. Future replay receives full original command, exact v2 parsing and ROOT verification against current authority, then compares outer digest AND DER-proof hash under locks before any grant or expired-family retirement. Stored hashes are not authorization, signatures, signing inputs or reconstructed/redacted originals; no access TTL extension. Raw device/recovery/deletion proofs retain their established nonsecret historical role. Public challenge and canonical passport storage remain unchanged.
recipes.server_envelope: D=SHA256(JCS(payload)); payload_sha256=lowerhex(D). Established identity key signs fixed negotiation domain||raw D; P1363 base64url. Version appears in payload AND envelope. Validate whole envelope bound and TTL separately.
recipes.self_bearer: JCS(document without request_sha256); fill digest. No device signature for start/decision; source active bearer/platform/device/family is authority. Complete positive fixture needs an authorized disposable context, not a fabricated JWT.
recipes.continuation: For RecoveryCommit, DeletionRequest and DeletionCancel retain full original nonsecret validated signed body/proof plus platform/version/binding and route identity in protected typed history under required historical bounds. Never append code/refresh headers; retain only existing family verifiers/hashes. Replay the same complete incoming object, including original requested_at/signature, using original commit domain, not outcome/receipt/resolve domain. Historical deletion-key exceptions, header authority and current-result checks remain independent.
recipes.server_evidence: Manual source policy only, no computed digest/signature: retain operation D where its existing recipe defines one, with unchanged omissions, AND distinct original_document_sha256=SHA256(JCS(full UNMODIFIED original request including original hash/signature or portable outer request/proof)). Portable ROOT still signs full JCS(request), never either storage digest or root_proof_sha256. Retain exact proof bytes EXCEPT portable REGISTER/LOGIN ROOT authorization, whose original DER proof is HASH-ONLY as specified by portable_root; preserve fixed algorithm/domain/version/platform/identity/public key/binding/operation evidence. For credential-bearing requests retain only necessary allowlisted nonsecret fields and existing credential hashes; never full recoverable server request/receipt/log, even encrypted. On exact committed replay validate complete original incoming request under its own v2 parser/domain/hash/proof and applicable authority, then compare stored original digest/proof/evidence/hashes (portable uses original DER-proof hash under locks). Never verify a redacted projection as original or treat hashes as authorization. Full nonsecret recovery/deletion proofs, public nonces and explicit canonical passport storage/authority are preserved.
